name: SK Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: SK Gas Co., Ltd. is a key player in the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) market, managing its supply and distribution across both South Korea and international territories. The company's operations further include the marketing and trading of LPG, alongside its involvement in the propane de-hydrogenation business. Additionally, SK Gas Co., Ltd. oversees the management of LPG storage facilities. The firm was established in 1985 and is headquartered in Seongnam, South Korea.
